{{Quote|Wow, this place lives up to its reputation.''"<br />"''Too bad no one can figure out how it works, or how to move it. We could sure use something like that.''"<br />"''It would make a great site for a base, except for the fact that every pirate in the sector knows about it.''"<br />"''Yeah, I just hope nobody else got here first.|[[Sian Tesar]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="RE" />}}
This '''unidentified planet''' was located in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two small [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="RE" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the location of a [[Unidentified city (Rethel Point)|ruined city]] that emanated a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field known as [[Rethel Point]]. The field spread across most of the planet, growing slightly weaker the farther it stretched from the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]], and ended just before reaching the orbital paths of the moons. It was rumored that a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Rethel]], had built the city at one [[Time/Legends|time]] long before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.<ref name="RE" />
